lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five to six horizontal rows along the visible lateral flank posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete high-luminance blobs are positioned at the nodes where faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments, creating a checkerboard pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple commensal fish (Echeneidae family) is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface of the shark.
